notes_info: TASK A-Z3 (reader A): sheets A424 (p33) and A425 (p37). 13 inventory tags, all assigned to walls; tags_descartados empty. 21 walls: 13 on A424, 8 on A425.

NEW vs EXISTING: on A424/A425 new walls are drawn with gray (0.75) stud poche and carry type tags; existing walls are white and tagged 'EXISTING' (wall legend on each sheet). Men's locker west wall, north walls, east exterior wall, shower south wall (y 1711.7-1721) and restroom south wall are existing to remain (AD101 D0.07 / solid lines on AD101) - not quantified. Women's area: north wall (with doors 152 / 133 openings), east wall, laundry-maintenance north line, janitor 138 north wall are existing (A425 'EXISTING' tags; AD101) - not quantified.

A101 tags C3C and B2E near the men's west wall point to walls WEST of the A424 dashed enlarged-plan boundary (A101 p14 crop): not on A424, not loaded here. A101 A6D tags on the men's shower west wall and ADA stall walls (untagged on A424) were used only as type source for A-A424-9/-11/-12.

Board: A111 finish-plan note 3 'LOCKER ROOMS, RESTROOMS, AND POOL AREAS TO BE MOISTURE RESISTANT GYP BOARD' + A301 '5/8" MR AT ALL WET ROOMS' -> 5/8" MR on locker/restroom/shower faces; janitors and laundry (mop sinks, A2.18 / A2.182) loaded MR as wet rooms (doubt D4); Maintenance Fitness 133 = 5/8" type X (spec 09 29 00 2.3.A interior board type X). Tile substrate recorded per face in 'tile_backer' (A301: 5/8" cement backer behind all tile; A424.C/A425.B elevation notes 14 DensShield and 15 DensArmor Plus at tile - product conflict for general task). Board never deducts openings (R80e.92).

FRP at mop sinks (A2.18 4'x4' FRP) EXCLUDED (FRP trade). Tile, toilet / shower / urinal partitions (A2.50 / A2.58 / A2.131, Chuze vendor), lockers, trough sinks EXCLUDED. Insulation (A6D 6" sound batt, X6D glass fiber) EXCLUDED. Concrete curb W/V at shower walls (A6D sill X*) EXCLUDED (concrete) - noted per wall.
Openings: door 131 (A-A424-2) and door 138 (A-A425-5) from A601 (3'-0" x 7'-0"); doors 152 / 133 sit in the existing north wall (not our walls).

Alt 1 (LOADED, conservative) 22'-10" = highest value printed on the locker-room elevations A425.B/A425.C; Alt 2 21'-4" (lowest B.O. DECK printed nearby, A423 sheet p32). Affects stud/board height (not LF) of A-A424-1/2/3/4/7/8/9/10/11/12 = 84.56 LF of wall; LF delta 0, stud and to-deck board height delta 1'-6" on those walls.

Layers per face not scheduled (X/A301 'see sched below') - 1 layer loaded.
